title: Belgian Chamber of Representatives Open Data: questions and speeches
description:
Dataset of all oral (plenary and committee) parliamentary questions posed in the Belgian Chamber of Representatives within session 56 (2024-2029). The data is compiled from official documents of the Belgian Chamber of Representatives (dekamer.be). The data contains question IDs, topics (NL + FR), questioners, questionees, respondents, discussion (speech transcript) in Parquet format.

This is an independent project, not affiliated with the Belgian Chamber of Representatives. The CC BY 4.0 license covers the compilation (structure, cleaning, linking); the underlying texts come from official Chamber documents, see NOTICE.md in the repository.
